\section{A chain, a hairline, a dashed corner}

Before the strokes, a chain of segments turns its corner as one path.

\begin{center}

  \draw[line width=3pt] (0,0) -- (2,0) -- (2,1.5);

  \draw[dashed, line width=1pt] (2.8,0) -- (3.4,1.5) -- (4,0);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
